title: Sony’s Top-Rated Wireless Headphones Are on Sale for Less Than $37: The Cheapest Price We’ve Ever Seen
summary: Ahead of Prime Day, the Sony WH-CH520 headphones are marked down by nearly 50% — here's how to buy them online.
contentText:

To get the most out of your music, you have to experience your favorite songs with high-quality audio to catch details, tones and clarity you’d otherwise miss with a subpar pair of headphones. But the Sony WH-CH520 Wireless Headphones deliver premium audio with punchy bass at a wallet-friendly price.

In fact, these top-rated headphones are on sale for their all-time lowest price ever, just $36.95 (regularly $69.99) on Amazon, while they have more than 24,000 five-star reviews from the retail giant. Shoppers like their premium hi-res audio, lightweight design and comfortable fit with soft earcups and long battery life of up to 50 hours per charge.

$36.95 $69.99 47% off

Buy Now On Amazon

The headphones also have a “music boost” feature that converts compressed music that you’d find on some streaming services into high-quality sound with Sony’s Digital Sound Enhancement Engine. This means, no matter your source of streaming music, you’ll get the best quality audio possible with these headphones. It’s such a great value since this feature can be found on more expensive pairs, like the Sony WH-1000XM6 — which retails for $460.

Meanwhile, the Sony WH-CH520 headphones have multipoint Bluetooth connectivity with Google Fast Pair, so you can quickly pair them to a smartphone and laptop at the same time. Additionally, if these headphones go missing, you can use Google’s Find Hub app to find their location. You can even activate a chime to locate them in a messy home.

LOWEST PRICE EVER

Sony WH-CH520 Wireless Headphones

And since these headphones are from Amazon, you’ll get it shipped to you for free if you’re a Prime member . Otherwise, your cart has to be more than $35 to get free shipping.

The Sony WH-CH520 Wireless Headphones , which come in black, are on sale for $36.95, or $33.04 off their list price, on Amazon — a 48% savings. But act fast and shop now, this deal is only available for a limited time.
